items.title: EXCLUSIVE: Navana AI 8-Year Bet on Indic Voice AI for Banks Is Now Priced at Rs 12 to Beat Everyone

items.title: Management Means You Never Log Off
items.summary: In episode 1029 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Katie Malone, Host of Linear Digressions about what actually changes when an engineer moves into management. She describes days spent bouncing from meeting to meeting and fielding pings across a bunch of different channels, with no real way to switch off, because the job becomes keeping everything moving and touching all the plates. Some days it feels like being in the Matrix, redirecting bullets. She is candid that the trade is not for everyone, noting that plenty of engineers would say it does not match their idea of a good day coding.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization Explained
items.summary: NVIDIA just dropped Nemotron 3 Diarization, a 100M-parameter open model that tells apart up to 8 speakers in real-time streaming audio. Pair it with a speech-to-text model like Parakeet and every line of your meeting notes knows who said it. It runs entirely locally, so your audio never leaves your machine. How it works: - Every fraction of a second, it decides which of 8 speakers is talking, even when two people talk at once - Speakers are numbered in the order they first show up - A small speaker memory keeps the labels stable when someone comes back later Links: Model: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Nemotron-3-Diarization NVIDIA blog: https://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/nemotron-diarization Live demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/nvidia/nemotron-diarization Parakeet (speech-to-text): https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 NeMo Speech toolkit: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech Streaming Sortformer paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.18446 Sortformer paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.06656 #shorts #nvidia #ai #speechrecognition #opensource
items.summary_html:
NVIDIA just dropped Nemotron 3 Diarization, a 100M-parameter open model that tells apart up to 8 speakers in real-time streaming audio. Pair it with a speech-to-text model like Parakeet and every line of your meeting notes knows who said it. It runs entirely locally, so your audio never leaves your machine.

How it works:
- Every fraction of a second, it decides which of 8 speakers is talking, even when two people talk at once
- Speakers are numbered in the order they first show up
- A small speaker memory keeps the labels stable when someone comes back later
